commands.name: uriel
commands.description: Uriel overview — what the mod does and how to get help.

commands.name: block
commands.description: Admin: block a prefab (by GUID or name) so it can't be spawned/discovered/granted. Usage: .uriel block <guid|name>

commands.name: blocklist
commands.description: Admin: list the blocked prefabs. Usage: .uriel blocklist

commands.name: bossmap
commands.description: Admin: edit the boss->object unlock map (defeating the V-blood grants the objects). Usage: .uriel bossmap <add|remove|list> [vblood] [object]

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Browse the full placeable-object catalog (paged) and see totals (total + discoverable). Usage: .uriel catalog [page]

commands.name: despawn
commands.description: Remove the nearest object you spawned (aim at it or stand near it). Usage: .uriel despawn

commands.name: features
commands.description: Admin: show which Uriel features are switched on (config file BepInEx/config/kdpen.Uriel.cfg). Usage: .uriel features

commands.name: finditem
commands.description: Search the item catalog by name. Usage: .uriel finditem <name fragment>

commands.name: findprefab
commands.description: Search spawnable placeable objects for '.uriel spawn'. Usage: .uriel findprefab <text> [page]

commands.name: forcedespawn
commands.description: Admin: force-remove the object you're aiming at, IGNORING Uriel ownership/records (recovers untracked objects, e.g. from older builds). Run once to arm (names it), then '.uriel forcedespawn confirm' within 30s. Usage: .uriel forcedespawn [confirm]

commands.name: forcepurgeplot
commands.description: Same as '.uriel purgeplot' — removes Uriel's objects on the plot (live spawns + records); native objects/plants/trees/build pieces are never touched. (Kept as a synonym; the old chain sweep was removed because it could delete native resources.) Usage: .uriel forcepurgeplot

commands.name: grant
commands.description: Admin: unlock an object for a player to build — covers non-destroyable objects discovery can't reach. Usage: .uriel grant <player> <name|guid>

commands.name: grantall
commands.description: Admin: grant a player ALL placeable objects (or a subset). Usage: .uriel grantall <player> [all|destructible|indestructible]

commands.name: help
commands.description: Uriel help menu. Usage: .uriel help [objects|storage|stairs|events|admin]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show the sharing rules of the aimed container (or '.uriel info nearest' for the closest one).

commands.name: killswitch
commands.description: Admin: restore vanilla server-wide. Stops every castle event (doors put back), removes every Uriel unit and every Uriel-spawned object, and makes every shared chest and prison cell private. Run once to arm, then '.uriel killswitch confirm' within 30 s. Usage: .uriel killswitch [confirm]

commands.name: lower
commands.description: Lower the nearest object you spawned so it sits lower / stops floating. Optional amount in metres (default 0.25). Stand near the object. Usage: .uriel lower [metres]

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move the nearest object you spawned to your aim point — or to YOUR location with 'here' (use this from a UI button). Stand near the object; aim where you want it (or pass 'here'), then run. Usage: .uriel move [here]

commands.name: notify
commands.description: Turn your object-discovery chat messages on or off. Usage: .uriel notify <on|off>

commands.name: objcfg
commands.description: Admin: set spawn conditions for ONE object. Fields: max <n> (max per plot, 0=unlimited) | cost <amount> <itemGuid> (0=free) | indestructible <true|false> | respawn <true|false> | yoffset <metres> (auto height-correct so it sits flush; applies to everyone) | clear | show. (max/cost/permits gate players only; yoffset applies to all.) Usage: .uriel objcfg <name|guid> <field> [v1] [v2]

commands.name: objcfgglobal
commands.description: Admin: set the GLOBAL DEFAULT spawn condition applied to every object unless that object overrides it (players only). Same fields as objcfg. Usage: .uriel objcfgglobal <field> [v1] [v2]

commands.name: objcfglist
commands.description: Admin: list the global + per-object spawn conditions. Usage: .uriel objcfglist

commands.name: paychest
commands.description: Designate the aimed PRIVATE chest to receive cost payments (or '.uriel paychest nearest').

commands.name: purgeall
commands.description: Admin: remove EVERY Uriel-spawned object on the server, on every plot. Native objects are never touched. Run once to arm, then '.uriel purgeall confirm' within 30 s. Usage: .uriel purgeall [confirm]

commands.name: purgeorphans
commands.description: Admin: scan the WHOLE map and remove orphaned Uriel objects — ones whose castle heart is gone (castle destroyed/decayed) or that sit where no living heart governs them. Only Uriel's own objects are touched; native objects are never affected. Server-wide on-demand backup for the automatic boot-time cleanup. Usage: .uriel purgeorphans

commands.name: purgeplot
commands.description: Remove Uriel's objects on the castle plot you're standing in (live spawns + tracked records). Native objects are never touched. For one specific untracked object, aim at it and use '.uriel forcedespawn'. Usage: .uriel purgeplot

commands.name: raise
commands.description: Raise the nearest object you spawned so it sits higher / flush with the ground. Optional amount in metres (default 0.25). Stand near the object. Usage: .uriel raise [metres]

commands.name: removestairs
commands.description: Cleanly remove the aimed staircase (the whole fused structure) WITHOUT disturbing the floors/walls it's connected to. You must own it. Usage: .uriel removestairs [nearest]

commands.name: revoke
commands.description: Admin: remove an object from a player's unlocks. Usage: .uriel revoke <player> <name|guid>

commands.name: rotate
commands.description: Rotate the nearest object you spawned. No arg turns it 90 degrees; 0-3 sets that tile rotation. Usage: .uriel rotate [0-3]

commands.name: share
commands.description: Share the aimed container. Optional stackable modifiers (any order): permission take|give|givetake, limithours <h>, limitwithdrawal <stacks>, cost <itemId> <amount>, nearest (target nearest container instead of aimed — for UI buttons).

commands.name: shared
commands.description: List every container YOU have made public, with its full sharing rules.

commands.name: sharedall
commands.description: (admin) List ALL public containers, or one player's: .uriel sharedall [name|steamId]

commands.name: sharedebug
commands.description: (admin) Dump the aimed container's live sharing state (team, castle link, prisoner) for diagnostics.

commands.name: spawn
commands.description: Spawn a prefab in the castle plot you're in. After the name, the rotation (0-3) and any flags may appear IN ANY ORDER: 'breakable' (raid/decay can destroy it), 'smashable' (you can destroy it too), 'respawn' (auto-comes-back until the castle's gone or you despawn it), 'here'/'nearest' (place at YOUR location — use this from a UI button), 'indestructible'. Admin-only 'force' spawns a non-networked object (e.g. an effect zone) that would otherwise be refused — it may be INVISIBLE. Default indestructible. Usage: .uriel spawn <name|guid> [rot 0-3] [flags…]. Players: own plot only; admins: any plot.

commands.name: spawninfo
commands.description: Inspect the nearest object you spawned (prefab, ownership, indestructible/decay flags, plot).

commands.name: spawnlist
commands.description: List the Uriel-spawned objects on the castle plot you're standing in. Usage: .uriel spawnlist

commands.name: stairpurge
commands.description: (admin) Destroy ALL stair entities within 5m of you — cleanup for invisible 'ghost' stairs from older builds. Restart the server afterwards.

commands.name: stairrefresh
commands.description: (admin, EXPERIMENTAL) Dump the aimed staircase's mega-static state to the server log; attempts a LIVE visual refresh only if [StairSwap] ExperimentalLiveRefresh is enabled. Does not affect the durable swap.

commands.name: stairstyles
commands.description: Show the aimed stair's shape, current style, and the styles available to you.

commands.name: stairswap
commands.description: Swap the aimed stair to another style of the same shape — applies LIVE (the stair is rebuilt in the new style; no restart needed). Usage: .uriel stairswap <stone1|stone2|stone3|gloomrot|projectk|strongblade|next>

commands.name: takeprisoner
commands.description: Take the prisoner from the SHARED cell you're aiming at — they're subdued and released to you (have Dominating Presence ready).

commands.name: unblock
commands.description: Admin: allow a previously blocked prefab again (use its GUID from '.uriel blocklist'). Usage: .uriel unblock <guid|name>

commands.name: unlocks
commands.description: List the objects you've unlocked for building. Admins can pass a player name to view theirs. Usage: .uriel unlocks [player]

commands.name: unshare
commands.description: Make the public container you're aiming at private again ((or '.uriel unshare nearest' for the closest one).

commands.name: unshareall
commands.description: (admin) Revert EVERY public container to private and clear the registry.

commands.name: unsharemine
commands.description: Revert EVERY container you shared (or control) back to private, in bulk.

commands.name: unshareplayer
commands.description: (admin) Revert ALL of one player's public containers: .uriel unshareplayer <name|steamId>

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Raphael: the total prefab list available in-game (paged). Usage: .uriel api catalog [page]

commands.name: unlocked
commands.description: Raphael: your unlocked prefabs + collection percentage (paged). Usage: .uriel api unlocked [page]

commands.name: version
commands.description: Raphael: object-spawn API version, capabilities + catalog totals.

commands.name: door
commands.description: Bind the castle door nearest you (within 6 m) to a group: during an event it stays shut and locked until every unit of the group is defeated, then opens. Usage: .uriel event door <group>

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show the last event runs on this plot (result, time, time to the last boss) and the best times per template. Usage: .uriel event history

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show this plot's event layout: groups by floor, their doors and markers. Usage: .uriel event list

commands.name: marker
commands.description: Place a spawn marker where you stand, in a group (made on its first marker, on the floor you're on). Slot mob or boss: where the squad's mobs or bosses stand. Unit: a name/GUID for a fixed spawn here, or - for the group's squad. Count/level: for a fixed unit. Contain: plot, room, storey, <m>, or - for the server default. Usage: .uriel event marker <group> [mob|boss] [unit|-] [count] [level] [contain|-]

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a marker (by its #number) or a whole group (by name) from this plot's layout; paid markers are refunded. Usage: .uriel event remove <#id|group>

commands.name: squad
commands.description: Give a group its own squad (- for none): what it spawns when the run's template doesn't cover it. Usage: .uriel event squad <group> <squad|->

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start this plot's event: each group rolls its squad (from the template, a floor template or a squad you name, else its own), every group's door shuts until that group is defeated. Options, comma-separated: easy|normal|hard|brutal, level=N, level+N, auto[+N] (highest player level here), hp*X, dmg*X, pp*X, sp*X, speed*X, aspd*X, limit=15m, faction=keep (units keep their own factions; by default the whole run is one side). Usage: .uriel event start [template|-] [options]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the running event on this plot: the clock, bosses left, time left, groups cleared, units left, doors. Usage: .uriel event status

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop this plot's event: its units are removed and its doors put back as they were. Usage: .uriel event stop

commands.name: stopall
commands.description: Admin: stop every castle event on the server: their units are removed and their doors put back as they were. Works with castle events switched off. Usage: .uriel event stopall

commands.name: undoor
commands.description: Unbind a group's door. Usage: .uriel event undoor <group>

commands.name: assign
commands.description: Give a layout group (by name, or * for every group on the floor) a squad; several comma-separated = one rolled per run; - unassigns. Usage: .uriel floor assign <name> <group|*> <squad[,squad...]|->

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a floor template. Usage: .uriel floor create <name>

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a floor template (yours, or any as admin). Usage: .uriel floor delete <name>

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the floor templates you can use. Usage: .uriel floor list

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a floor template's groups and squads. Usage: .uriel floor show <name>

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add an entry to a squad's set (set 1 by default; the next number starts a new combination, one combination rolled per run). Role mob or boss. Units: one or more, comma-separated. Pick any = each unit at random (an assortment), distinct = that many different ones (1 of these 3 bosses). Level 0 = the unit's own. Usage: .uriel squad add <name> <mob|boss> <unit[,unit...]> [count] [any|distinct] [level] [set]

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a squad (an admin's is server-wide, a player's is their own). Usage: .uriel squad create <name>

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a squad (yours, or any as admin). Usage: .uriel squad delete <name>

commands.name: extend
commands.description: Add more units to an entry's list (a chat line is short, so a long list takes several commands). Usage: .uriel squad extend <name> <set> <entry> <unit[,unit...]>

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the squads you can use. Usage: .uriel squad list

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an entry from a squad's set, or the whole set (entry 0). Usage: .uriel squad remove <name> <set> [entry]

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a squad's sets and entries. Usage: .uriel squad show <name>

commands.name: weight
commands.description: How often a squad's set is rolled, relative to its other sets (default 1). Usage: .uriel squad weight <name> <set> <1-100>

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a castle-wide event template. Usage: .uriel template create <name>

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a template (yours, or any as admin). Usage: .uriel template delete <name>

commands.name: floor
commands.description: Give a floor (1, 2, ... or * for every floor) a floor template; several comma-separated = one rolled per floor per run (a theme); - clears. Usage: .uriel template floor <name> <floor|*> <floor template[,...]|->

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the templates you can use. Usage: .uriel template list

commands.name: options
commands.description: Default run options for a template (the start's own options add to them): easy|normal|hard|brutal, level=N, level+N, auto[+N], hp*X, dmg*X, pp*X, sp*X, speed*X, aspd*X, limit=15m, faction=keep|one; - for none. Usage: .uriel template options <name> <options|->

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a template's floors and options. Usage: .uriel template show <name>

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Remove every Uriel unit on the castle plot you're standing in. Usage: .uriel unit clear

commands.name: despawn
commands.description: Remove the nearest Uriel unit within the radius (default 10 m). Usage: .uriel unit despawn [radius]

commands.name: door
commands.description: Spike 7: drive the nearest castle door of this plot within 6 m from the server: open, close, lock (players can't use it), unlock, or show. Usage: .uriel unit door <open|close|lock|unlock|show>

commands.name: kill
commands.description: Kill the Uriel units within the radius (default 15 m): all, boss or mob. A real death (event groups clear, doors open), unlike despawn. Only Uriel's own units. Usage: .uriel unit kill [radius] [all|boss|mob]

commands.name: list
commands.description: Count the Uriel units on the server, per plot. Usage: .uriel unit list

commands.name: probe
commands.description: Read the tile map where you stand (or at your aim point): height level, and free/blocked and ground/air for nearby levels. Label it for the log. Usage: .uriel unit probe [label] [here|aim]

commands.name: probemap
commands.description: Write an ASCII map of the tile map around you to the server log ('#' blocked, '.' floor, ' ' no ground), at your height level and the one above. Usage: .uriel unit probemap [label] [radius 2-20]

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Kill switch: remove EVERY Uriel unit on the server. Run once to arm, then '.uriel unit purge confirm' within 30 s. Usage: .uriel unit purge [confirm]

commands.name: rooms
commands.description: Write the castle's rooms (the game's own: floors, storeys, enclosed or not) and a map of the plot per storey to the server log. Room containment keeps a unit in the room it spawned in. Usage: .uriel unit rooms

commands.name: spawn
commands.description: Spawn NPC units into the castle plot you're in, 2.5 m in front of you ('aim' = at your aim point). Optional level (0 = the prefab's own). Units never leave the plot; 'contain' narrows that: room, storey, a leash radius in metres, or a mix like room,15. Usage: .uriel unit spawn <name|guid> [count] [level] [here|aim] [plot|room|storey|<m>]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Write each Uriel unit within the radius (default 30 m) to the server log: position, height level, health, behaviour state, target. Usage: .uriel unit status [radius]
